name: Cube Day Macomb 2020

venue.name: Lorenzo Cultural Center at Macomb Community College
venue.address: Lorenzo Cultural Center, Garfield Road, Clinton Township, MI

information: # This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Macomb Community College is hosting its first cube competition! This event is a competition presented in partnership with the World Cube Association and CubingUSA, and will feature up to 100 competitors in multiple events. The public is welcome to observe the competition, but seating is limited.
